hebrewText: רֹעֶ֣ה אֵ֔פֶר לֵ֥ב הוּתַ֖ל הִטָּ֑/הוּ וְ/לֹֽא יַצִּ֤יל אֶת נַפְשׁ/וֹ֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יֹאמַ֔ר הֲ/ל֥וֹא שֶׁ֖קֶר בִּ/ימִינִֽ/י

tokens.bdb: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively, to graze (literally or figuratively); generally to rule; by extension, to associate with (as a friend)
